rationale: The instrument spiked to 26.55 and has been distributed all session back to the lower third of its range, trading below the 5-minute VWAP and 9-EMA — but that fade has now stalled into a $0.02–0.04 consolidation on falling volume (last five bars 1–4k shares), so neither the bearish fade nor a reclaim has confirmed. With 11 minutes to close, no news catalyst, and 5-minute ATR collapsed to $0.02 (~8bps), there is insufficient time and expected movement for either direction to clear costs. This is also a crypto-proxy fund whose next move is driven by an external market I have no current read on, making an EOD entry a coin flip after the spread.
